sections.title: Page 14
sections.text:
Forging a Future of Shared Prosperity
India’s ‘Neighbourhood First’ policy is a dynamic and adaptive strategy aimed at building a secure,
stable, and prosperous South Asia. It is a commitment to developing mutually beneficial, people-centered
regional frameworks anchored in the principles of mutual respect and collaborative growth.
